request: Reduce ineffective coverage predictions when the current human Pokemon can finish the trainer
scope: Shared humanTrainerAI for Adventure, Rift NPCs and Colosseum; no wild random AI, rosters, battle mechanics, frontend/schema or real account reset
rootCause: Switch forecast ignored a safe immediate KO opportunity; identical terminal scores in doomed stay-in branches let even a small switch chance dominate immune coverage

policy.finishingPressure: Max credible publicly estimated lethal reply, adjusted for accuracy, visible status, charge, and an earlier reliable counter-KO; priority and Trick Room respected, ties uncertain
policy.switchWeight: Existing habit/matchup forecast multiplied by 1 - 0.94 * pressure, minimum 0.005; no prediction of certainty
policy.currentTarget: When a damaging alternative can affect the current foe, learned/type immunity receives a 40 * pressure score cost so rare escape scenarios do not dominate
policy.preserved: Opponent roster/moves public; private stats/items/abilities and pending command excluded; historical observations, usable PP/items, ace rules, defensive switches, forced actions and pre-prompt commitment retained
policy.previews: Fixed/level damage, weather/Ion Deluge and own known move-type conversions; private clones for mutation-prone transformations such as Protean; existing per-analysis caches retained

targeted.command: node --test tests/human-trainer-finishing.test.js tests/human-trainer-ai.test.js tests/colosseum-ai.test.js tests/colosseum-variety.test.js tests/colosseum-ascension.test.js tests/drift-runtime.test.js tests/battle-order.test.js tests/battle-field.test.js tests/automatic-move-regressions.test.js

mysql.scope: Disposable SQL players; real Adventure pre-prompt commitment/invalid input/switch/attack and PP execution, no late retarget; accounts deleted

sweep.coverage: Four Ground species, three NPC HP states, three speed values, normal/Trick Room and switch habits; only inferred lethal situations without a reliable earlier counter-KO

simulation.limit: 48 fixed small-roster matches, 16 per policy; useful regression sample, not a general strength proof or concurrent-load benchmark

limits: Public stat estimates remain uncertain; no guarantee of knowing private item/talent/K or the actual next move
No frontend rebuild necessary; public assets byte-verified unchanged
No physical hardware or full global suite claim
